findings.comment: The description says 'the covariant type of the phantom-referenced object, must be a subtype of `AnyRef`'. Both pieces of extra information are already encoded in the signature `[+T <: AnyRef]`: the `+` communicates covariance and `<: AnyRef` communicates the bound. Per the altitude rule, @tparam text should not restate what the signature already shows. Prefer: 'the type of the phantom-referenced object'.
